analysis.reasonEn: Following two consecutive days of 0.12% gains, today's 0.12% rise continues the sideways consolidation. RSI is declining from overbought but remains above 60, indicating continued strength. MACD histogram improvement has slowed but stays positive. Volume is subdued at 0.28x the 5-day average, suggesting a period of directional search. Price is consolidating between SMA5 ($2,701.75) resistance and SMA20 ($2,567.29) support. With an ATR of $94.58, a 1.3x ATR stop loss ($122.95) would be at $2,570.68, and a 2.6x ATR target ($245.93) would be at $2,939.56, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1.99. The current price of $2,693.63 is approaching the SMA5 resistance. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
